source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The URI syntax is defective, but the item, member suffix and acceptance text consistently target OAM_7 static parity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All missing items are supplyable approvals or runtime prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Defines trustworthy OAM_7 identity and exhaustive three-way evidence while keeping adjacent thermal coverage separate.
independent_technical_reasoning: As the last module in a repeated collection, OAM_7 is especially vulnerable to off-by-one association between API member, service label and Web tab. The comparison must establish the same stable identity on both surfaces before values are considered. Web refresh lag is evidence quality, not a reason for automatic retry, because repeated polling could conceal a persistent cache defect.
